scene_description: A young boy wearing a blue hoodie and blue sneakers is sitting on green grass, leaning against a tree trunk. American flags are displayed on poles along the roadside nearby. A road and trees are visible in the background.

questions.question: Who is in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person sitting on the grass.

questions.question: What is the boy doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boy's body and where he is.

questions.question: Where is the boy sitting?
verbal_choices: on the grass by a tree
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is under the boy and what is behind him.

questions.question: What do you see on the poles near the road?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall poles near the road in the background.

questions.question: How do you think the boy feels sitting quietly by the tree?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boy's body — he is sitting still and quiet by the tree.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever sat outside on the grass? Where was it?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside sitting on the grass.
